finding: No literal signed downward-progress penalty. One matched, physically completed scripted recovery earns greater full discounted job return than continued insertion to deadline under the unchanged resolved FORGE reward.
decision: Keep the unchanged resolved upstream reward. This feasible recovery is favored over its persistent stall; no shared reward correction is justified by this pair. This does not establish learning or reward compatibility across the future fault support.
required_next_check: Validate numeric recoverable fault support and implement/freeze training terminal and bootstrap handling. Check additional matched development faults before a learning campaign; no final-test selection.
scope_and_limitations: Source audit plus one recorded scripted development pairing; not proof that PPO learns recovery or that targeted training improves reliability.
The analytic proximity examples remain partial rewards, not full trajectory returns.
The unrecorded and recorded successful recovery runs repeat the same seed and case; they are not independent experimental replicates.
All four jobs in each paired arm are retained, including a shared force abort and unrecovered deadline case.
Only control reward endpoints at/before evaluator termination; later rewards zero, no bootstrap. Partial terminal interval omitted. Training integration is not implemented.
The -0.1 action-change coefficient in the earlier source-only interpretation is explicitly superseded by the observed instantiated value 0.0.
